subject: Full-day panel orchestration: Ethan Zhou (SWE)
messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, ethan.zhou@example.com Cc: tina@talentify.io Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700 Subject: Full-day panel orchestration: Ethan Zhou (SWE) Hi all — We want to lock Ethan's full virtual onsite this week. Proposed plan (goal: 4 x 45-min slots + 30-min debrief): - 10:00–10:45: System design (Marissa) - 11:15–12:00: Product + use-case (Mina) - 13:00–13:45: Coding + pair (Karhtik) - 15:00–15:45: Culture/team fit (Laura) - 16:15–16:45: Debrief (internal only) Key asks: please confirm you can take these slots or propose a max 30-min shift. We need: - explicit interviewer roles (lead / backup) - buffer windows for candidate breaks and AV checks (we prefer 30 min between 2nd and 3rd slot) - any materials you want in the candidate brief (coding problem link, design doc, rubric) Attached: candidate-brief-EZ-10-14.pdf (resume + short notes). Ethan / Tina: are you available for the candidate-facing times above? If that doesn't work we'll propose two alternate half-day options. Thanks — Karthik Iyer Staff Eng, Redwood Inference From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai Cc: ethan.zhou@example.com, tina@talentify.io Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 10:04:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Full-day panel orchestration: Ethan Zhou (SWE) Karthik — Thanks for the draft. A few practical notes from scheduling/ops perspective: - I can own the candidate intro + culture slot (15:00) and be the debrief scribe if Marissa can't. - Recommend tightening the candidate-facing day: move coding to 12:30–13:15 to avoid the long lunch gap. That leaves a 45-min lunch (12:00–12:45) and still preserves a 30-min break before the culture slot. - Please designate a backup for the coding slot in case of last-minute conflicts. - I'll create a panel-runbook (template attached) with: quick bios, scoring rubric, timezone notes, and AV checklist. I'll push calendar holds after folks confirm availability. Also: we should ask Ethan if he prefers Google Meet or Zoom (we default to Meet unless requested). Attachment: panel-runbook-template.docx (stub) —Laura Laura Bennett Recruiting Operations, Redwood Inference From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai Cc: ethan.zhou@example.com, tina@talentify.io Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 12:30:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Full-day panel orchestration: Ethan Zhou (SWE) All — I can take system design (10:00) and will be lead interviewer there. I can also prep a 3-slide prompt for the design exercise (I'll drop into the candidate brief). Notes / micro-adjustment: - Agree with Laura on shifting coding to 12:30–13:15. That yields a shorter lunch but keeps momentum for a remote day. - Backup for coding: Logan Wright is available as a standby; I'll ping him now and loop in calendar if he confirms.
I'll await Ethan's confirmation and will add the design prompt to Drive (link will be in the runbook). —Marissa Marissa Cole Staff Engineer, Platforms From: Ethan Zhou To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai Cc: tina@talentify.io Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 15:45:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Full-day panel orchestration: Ethan Zhou (SWE) Hi Karthik / Laura — Thanks for coordinating. The proposed day works for me with the adjusted timing: I'll do Meet and the 12:30 coding slot is fine. A couple of practical items: - I have a conflict at 11:40–12:10 but the 11:15–12:00 product slot is OK; I'll step away for a short break. - I've attached an updated resume (the PDF includes a link to my GitHub). - Preferred pronouns: he/him. Attachment: Ethan_Zhou_Resume.pdf (stub) Best, Ethan From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai Cc: ethan.zhou@example.com, tina@talentify.io Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 16:03:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Full-day panel orchestration: Ethan Zhou (SWE) — Final schedule and invites Team — Finalized (calendar invites sent): - 10:00–10:45 PT: System design — Marissa (lead) | Logan Wright (backup) - 11:15–12:00 PT: Product/use-case — Mina - 12:30–13:15 PT: Pair coding — Karthik (lead) | Logan (standby) - 15:00–15:45 PT: Culture/team — Laura (lead) - 16:15–16:45 PT: Debrief (internal only) — Laura (scribe) Links: Google Calendar invites have Meet links; runbook and candidate brief live in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3-panel-runbooks Prep requests (please confirm by 09:00 PT day-of): - Come with 3 takeaways + 1 question for the candidate for each slot - Add any scoring notes directly to the runbook (I added the rubric) - If you need to swap, give 24 hours notice; Logan is on standby for the coding/design slots. Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn. I'll mute the debrief invite if any final conflicts come in. Karthik Iyer Staff Eng, Redwood Inference
